messages:
sanjay (AE): quick heads-up — HelixAI's POC rerank flow failed during a live demo prep. they see dims mismatch errors and can't proceed. demo is tomorrow, can we swarm? :grimacing:

ella (Support): can you paste the error and the request they sent?

sanjay (AE): log from their infra:
```
2026-02-14T18:02:15Z ERROR reranker.service: embedding dimension mismatch: expected=1536 actual=768 at /app/rerank/process.go:87
request_id=abc-123 user=helixai env=staging
input_count=12 model_alias=embed-lite
```

matt (SE): 429s or timeouts too? or just dim mismatch?

sanjay (AE): only the dim mismatch in the stack trace, no 429s in the last run. they did mention switching models earlier this week to test cost-savings.

priya (ML): ok — most likely root cause is the client used a smaller embedding model alias (768-dim) while their reranker expects 1536. need to confirm the exact model returned and the vector length the SDK is handing to them. can we get a raw embed response?

ella (Support): asked them for the raw response and the SDK call they used. they returned this snippet: 
```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite",
  "input": ["How do I reset my password?"],
  "embeddings": [[-0.0123, 0.0045, ... (768 values) ... , 0.0021]]
}
```

priya (ML): confirmed — embed-lite is a 768-dim model. their reranker code is hard-coded to 1536 dims. short-term fixes: 1) switch client to rwd-embed-1536, 2) update reranker to accept variable dims and fail fast with a clear error message. long-term: we should surface model vector_dim in the SDK response metadata and include a validation helper.

matt (SE): quick patch we suggested to them (JS):
```js
// guard before passing to reranker
if (embeddings[0].length !== expectedDim) {
  throw new Error(`Embedding dimension mismatch: expected ${expectedDim}, got ${embeddings[0].length}`)
}
```

priya (ML): also checked our routing: there was an alias mapping change last week where 'embed-lite' was introduced as a cost-optimized 768 model and some clients auto-suggest it. for POCs we should avoid alias collisions in the quickstarts or mark them explicitly in the console.

sanjay (AE): customer is on a tight budget and tried the alias intentionally. can we give guidance on cost tradeoffs + an easy toggle? they asked about pricing delta and latency impact.

priya (ML): rough guidance: embed-lite (768) ~40% cheaper and ~20% faster on average; rwd-embed-1536 gives better downstream rerank quality. for a rerank POC, recommend sticking with 1536 or run A/B on a small eval set. i can help craft a short note you can send.

ella (Support): they also reported intermittent rate limit warnings earlier, but that seems like separate issue tied to their env burst. flagged for follow-up if it recurs.

matt (SE): to help them unblock quickly — changed the demo script to request rwd-embed-1536 explicitly and added the guard that fails loudly. sent patch to their repo.

sanjay (AE): relayed to HelixAI; they applied the change and re-ran the demo.

helixai (via support DM): "demo green ✅ — reranker accepted vectors and scores look reasonable. thanks!"

priya (ML): follow-ups: 1) we should add a warning in the Console when an alias is not dimension-compatible with the last-used reranker config; 2) SDK should include vector_dim in response metadata; 3) add a small FAQ blurb in quickstarts about "embedding dims and rerankers". i'll open tickets.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-02-14T19:01:02Z success — console/quickstart-docs/embeddings-dims-warning v1.0

ella (Support): i'll close the POC incident but track the rate-limit note as a separate ticket. thanks everyone for the fast turnaround :tada:

sanjay (AE): awesome — i'll update the customer and include the cost/quality note.

priya (ML): leaving a tiny snippet they can drop into the SDK to validate dims server-side (python):
```py
def assert_embedding_dims(embeddings, expected):
    if len(embeddings) == 0:
        raise ValueError('no embeddings')
    if len(embeddings[0]) != expected:
        raise ValueError(f'embedding dimension mismatch: expected={expected} got={len(embeddings[0])}')
```

matt (SE): saved — will add to our troubleshooting checklist.

sanjay (AE): closing loop w/ customer; demo retained for tomorrow. thanks all.
